inlines.v: APPERTA'IN, verb intransitive [Latin ad and pertineo, to pertain, of per and teneo, to hold. Pertineo is to reach to, to extend to, hence to belong. See Tenant.] To belong, whether by right, nature or appointment. Give it to him to whom it appertaineth. Leviticus 6:5. [See Pertain.]
